description: Option-click any jack, knob, switch, button, light or module title in the rack, or use the combination chosen in the menu, and a note says what it does

params.text: Turns the gesture on and off. While it is lit, the gesture opens a note; while it is dark, it does what it would do without this module
Reads a note aloud as well as showing it. While it is lit, click any line of an open note and that line is spoken in the voice the system is set to

notes: click bare panel or press Escape to close a note; click another control to replace it.
no inputs, no outputs, no effect on the sound. One in the patch answers for the whole rack.
with the speak button lit, clicking a line of an open note reads it aloud in the system voice.
a jack's note gives polyphony, the voltage that moves it over its full travel, level or edge, and what an unpatched jack reads.
help comes from the maker's own help file first, then your own in the Rack user folder, then this plugin's database; a note from either file says so.
a module with no entry says so. Corrections: github.com/chrisgr99/DreamerHelp
menu: Note text size: 80% to 250% — kept for you, not with the patch.
Ask for help with: option-click by default, or another modifier and click — kept for you, not with the patch.
Reload help files: reads every help file again, after one has been edited.
Export help files for: writes a starting help file for every module of a plugin in the rack, into a folder you choose.
